requirement: Launch a subprocess in a given directory with an environment built from an allowlist of inherited variables plus validated overrides, so parent secrets never reach the child, and fail loudly on bad directories or exit codes.
skeleton: An INHERITED_VARS allowlist, child_env copying allowed variables from os.environ or a base mapping and validating overrides, and run_isolated checking cwd and calling subprocess.run with env and check=True.
caption: Running a child process with a minimal environment. child_env(overrides=None, *, base=None) reads os.environ unless base is given and copies only INHERITED_VARS, PATH, LANG and HOME, that are present, so secrets never leak to the child. Each override key must be non-empty and contain no equals sign, else ValueError saying invalid variable name; overrides replace inherited values. run_isolated(argv, *, cwd, overrides=None) raises NotADirectoryError when cwd is not a directory, then calls subprocess.run with cwd, env=child_env(overrides), captured text output, a 60 second timeout and check=True, so a non-zero exit raises subprocess.CalledProcessError. The fixture asserts that a base with AWS_SECRET and PS1 keeps only PATH and HOME, that overrides add and win, that an empty or A=B key raises ValueError, that a child run in tmp_path sees that cwd, the MODE override and no monkeypatched SECRET_TOKEN, that a missing cwd raises NotADirectoryError, and that exit 4 raises CalledProcessError with returncode 4.

plan.intent: Run build tools without exposing the service's credentials
constraints: Only PATH, LANG and HOME are inherited
Override names must be non-empty and contain no equals sign, else ValueError
A cwd that is not a directory raises NotADirectoryError

rationale.teaches: Build subprocess environments from an allowlist instead of copying os.environ, validate variable names, and pass cwd and check explicitly.
rationale.why: Inheriting the full environment hands tokens to every child, names with equals signs corrupt the environment block, and check=False hides failed commands.

ops.docstring: Run a child process with a minimal, explicit environment.

candidates.why_wrong: The whole parent environment is copied, secrets included.
Variable names containing an equals sign are accepted.
A missing cwd surfaces as FileNotFoundError from subprocess instead of NotADirectoryError.
Failed commands return normally because check is disabled.
The base mapping is ignored and os.environ is always read.
